fusions.name: Road Roller
fusions.desc: Rolls a flattening drum over everything in a narrow cone 5 tiles long. It deals 32 damage, plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Pile Driver
fusions.desc: Drops the full weight of your ride on the target. It deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Riveted Panels
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage dealt to you is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Paved Over
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%.
